conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister, or Coda first.
Ergo Glast never sells the Tetra; his Corrupted Holokey shop only carries Grigori, Livia, Exec, Agendus and Ferrox. Every ranged Tenet weapon comes from a Sister.

rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Tetra Sister

conditions: A Treasurer spawns 2-5 minutes into any non-endless Corpus Ship mission and drops a Crown tiered by level; level 31+ or Steel Path drops the Zenith, the only tier that spawns a Candidate.
Open the Void far from extraction and walk out slowly afterward: within roughly 200m of extraction, or sprinting out, suppresses the Candidate spawn entirely.
If the preview isn't Tetra, leave her and complete and extract from the mission. Aborting does not remove that weapon from the pool; only a completed rejection does.

The Sister-carried pool is 11 weapons (Arca Plasmor, Cycron, Detron, Diplos, Envoy, Flux Rifle, Glaxion, Plinx, Quanta, Spirex, Tetra), so correctly rejecting guarantees Tetra inside 11 completed missions.
Only the player who dealt the final hit can Mercy, and one adversary blocks another: an active Kuva Lich or Coda has to be cleared or finished first.
bonuses: Xoris heavy attacks, Octavia's Mallet or a wide-nuke frame like Uriel trivialize the Void; summoning your Railjack On Call crew specter before it pulls you in helps too.
Only 25 kills are needed for rank 1 rewards; 75 is the cap.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal Requiems, test the sequence
groups.mode: long missions first, then fast ones
conditions: Requiem mods all come from the single Requiem Eterna relic (all 8 mods at equal chance), from Kuva Siphon (50%) or Kuva Flood (100%); Hounds have a 5% relic chance.
Run long missions (Survival, Excavation, Defense) on her nodes first for Murmurs, then short ones (Capture, Exterminate) to get her to spawn.
Down her three times to make her leave if you have no clue to test yet; she keeps her progress.
Failing a Parazon attempt levels the Sister up, raising every node she controls.
bonuses: Stock 1-2 of every Requiem before starting, from spare Requiem Eterna relics.

disclosures.title: Oull-first Parazon
disclosures.body: Multiple independent guides agree: slot Oull as a wildcard so each encounter tests one Requiem position, guaranteeing a kill by the 4th attempt. Don't stab until you have a new clue to test, but keep stabbing with already-confirmed ones. You usually won't have Oull for your first Sister; it drops from Sister Parazon attempts.

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert: Convert gives an ally and a tradeable Sister token but no weapon.
Needs Railjack Intrinsics rank 3; slot shields and hull mods before the confrontation, or don't host.
Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy you've invested in: the donor's Catalyst, Forma, Exilus adapter and Elemental Vice are all destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, 20 platinum from the Market, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.
